text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In Kyoto, where the chrysanthemums linger, 
the queens gather side by side. Upon whom 
will the glorious crown shine...! The 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober. ...The big race is finally upon 
us, isn't it~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright... you came.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ After all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You intend to start drawing from this 
point, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "The New Glory of Mejiro"—that brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...That's the plan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In that case, I simply cannot miss this~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Be sure to win, Dober. My dearest 
comrade.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I've been waiting for this day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, the "Empress." I shall face 
you with every ounce of my being.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Let's settle this. —Mejiro Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to this day as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll hit Senpai with everything the 
current me has...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you still believe in my strength, even 
now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The answer is already set in stone. I'll 
say it again, as many times as it takes.
choice_data_list: Mejiro Dober is a strong Uma Musume.

Mejiro Dober is a strong Uma Musume, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Then keep your eyes on me and don't 
look away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
With my strength, I'll etch my name into 
history—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Watch me spread my wings toward new glory!
